one_liner: Ecommerce widget/platform (by Lightspeed) that can be embedded into any website, with a REST API.

auth.notes: Ecwid REST API is OAuth2-only; apps request a public (read-only) or private (read/write) access token per store via the OAuth2 flow.

access.notes: Ecwid has a free store plan and a self-serve developer app registration process; did not verify a hard cap on free stores this pass.

api.notes: Covers products, orders, customers, categories. Rate limit noted as 600 req/min/token in Ecwid's own docs per search summary.

verdict.rationale: Free store tier plus a straightforward self-serve OAuth2 app registration with no extra production gate found.
